name: Answer correctness
definition: Share of answerable questions whose answer passes its grading rules (GR1, GR3, GR4).
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: Citation validity
definition: Share of answerable questions whose citations pass GR5: at least one answer-key source cited and no wrong file cited.
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: Correct refusal
definition: Share of unanswerable and out-of-node questions where the system says insufficient knowledge and leaks nothing (GR2).
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: False refusal
definition: Share of answerable questions where the system wrongly says insufficient knowledge (the phrase check of GR2).
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: Answer faithfulness
definition: Share of claims in an answer that the retrieved chunks support, checked by a judge with a written rubric. Trust it only after the judge probe of Phase 2 and a human spot check.

name: Retrieval hit
definition: Share of answerable questions where at least one of the top k retrieved chunks comes from an answer-key source file.
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e1-first

name: Context precision
definition: Of the chunks retrieved for a question, the share that come from an answer-key source file, averaged over the questions.
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e1-first

name: Context recall
definition: Of the answer-key source files for a question, the share that appear among the retrieved chunks, averaged over the questions.
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e1-first

name: Version handling
definition: Share of the three version questions answered correctly: version 2 figures for Q01 and Q02, the version 1 figure for Q26.
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: Duplicate detection recall
definition: Planted exact-duplicate pairs that the system finds, divided by planted pairs. The case study has one pair (D12 and its copy), so add pairs before trusting this number.
data: the D12 file and its copy

name: False duplicate alarms
definition: Number of files wrongly flagged as exact duplicates. D10 version 1 and version 2 are two versions, not duplicates, and must not be flagged.

name: Duplicate cited once
definition: Share of duplicate questions where the answer cites the duplicated document once (GR4).
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: Scanned text recovery
definition: Share of the required facts of Q12 and Q13 that appear in the text the LVM reads from the image-only D19.
data: Q12;Q13 with D19 as an image
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, glm-ocr-q8, clean and degraded page, results/e4-first

name: Terminal node accuracy
definition: Share of terminal-node questions answered correctly from the one summary document of the node.
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: Sub-issue suggestion recall
definition: Of the known sub-issues of I01 (I02, I03, I04), the share that the system suggests, matched by a human.
data: I01 and its sub-issues in issues.csv

name: Solution usefulness
definition: Average human rating from 1 to 5 of the probable solution the system suggests for each issue, using a rubric written in Phase 9.

name: Research gap recall
definition: Share of the planted research gaps that the system flags: the Route 7 versus Route 12 conflict (Q06) and the missing metro budget (Q23).

name: Judge and human agreement
definition: Share of packages where the judge and a human make the same accept or reject decision at the judge threshold.

name: Judge score gap
definition: Average absolute difference between the judge score and the human score for the same package.

name: Judge repeatability
definition: Share of items where the judge gives the same decision when it runs twice on the same input with the same settings.
data: the same 20 packages; in Phase 2 the judge probe
baseline_source: Phase 2 judge probe on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini, fixed settings, 52 items, results/e5-first

name: Package detail fit
definition: Share of packages whose detail level matches what the parent's layer needs (executive, managerial, or technical summary), rated by a human.
data: packages from N6 to N4 and from N4 to N1 and from N1 to N0

name: Time to first token
definition: Seconds from sending a question to the first generated token, median over a run.
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: Generation speed
definition: Generated tokens divided by generation time, median over a run.
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: Question latency
definition: Seconds from asking one question to the full answer, retrieval included: the median and the 90th percentile over the 26 questions.
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: Peak memory
definition: Highest GPU memory and system memory used while a model runs, read from nvidia-smi and the process list.
baseline: 3255 MB of GPU memory in use, including about 1168 MB used by Windows
baseline_source: Phase 2 run on 2026-10-28, phi4-mini with qwen3-embedding-0.6b, words80, k=3, results/e3-first (regraded)

name: Rule test coverage
definition: Share of the test areas required by the unit-testing rules that have at least one passing test.

name: RFP section completeness
definition: Share of the required RFP sections that are present in the draft RFP for I06. The section list is written in Phase 13.

name: Critique traceability
definition: Share of critique points in the feedback on a sample RFP response that point to an RFP criterion.
